descriptions.text: Cheat Code Potion Warning: This item has a short shelf life. This item will expire shortly after it was generated. In other words, this isn't something you can hoard. Don't be a wuss. Drink it now. Causes one, recently-used combat or magic-themed skill to increase by three. Choice is random and permanent.

beats.headline: Seventeen minutes to drink it
beats.text: The silver boss box holds a hundred gold coins and a potion with a red timer flashing at the bottom of its description, already down to seventeen minutes. Cheat Code Potion: don't be a wuss, drink it now. Carl adds it to his hotlist and drinks, and it crackles in his mouth like a whole packet of Pop Rocks. His Pugilism goes up by three, to level ten. With Iron Punch, Powerful Strike and his unarmed bonus, his fists now pack as much damage as Brandon's lightning maul.

beats.headline: Already at ten
beats.text: Among the classes on offer, Prizefighter adds three to Pugilism, which would be a huge bonus, Carl thinks, considering the Cheat Code potion has already taken the skill to ten. He would pick the class in a second if he thought he could just punch his way through the dungeon. He knows already that he can't.

beats.headline: Precious, and perishable
beats.text: Why is Pawna's Tears so valuable, Katia wants to know, when they have seen skill potions, potions that max a skill out, and Cheat Code potions that give three levels? Because it is plus five to any skill he chooses, Mordecai answers. Legendary potions that max a skill exist only for a few skills. The Cheat Code is also precious, plus three to a random skill. However, it has a short shelf life, so it has to be taken immediately.
